scripts.build:umd: vite build --config vite.config.js --base=./ && vite build --config vite.config_inject.js --base=./
scripts.build: tsup --config tsup.config.ts && npm run build:forTests && npm run build:min && npm run build:umd
scripts.demo: npm run build:forTests && rm -rf demos/dist && cp -r dist demos/dist && npx http-server demos/ --cors
scripts.demo-win: npm run build && npx http-server demos/
scripts.test: npm run build:forTests && npm run test:unit && jest --maxWorkers=1
scripts.pub: npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.pretest-playwright: npm run build:forTests && node preplaywrighttest.cjs && tsc --incremental -p playwright/e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest-demos: npm run build:forTests && node preplaywrighttest.cjs && tsc --incremental -p playwright/e2e/tsconfig.json
